definitions.gloss: lessons, classes taken as a hobby or for personal development
definitions.explanation: Regular lessons or classes taken outside of school or work, typically as a hobby or for self-improvement. Includes activities like piano, swimming, calligraphy, martial arts, and similar pursuits.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{習|なら}い{事|ごと}をさせる。
examples.english: To have one's child take lessons.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}はピアノと{水泳|すいえい}の{習|なら}い{事|ごと}をしている。
examples.english: My daughter takes piano and swimming lessons.

examples.japanese: {大人|おとな}になってから{新|あたら}しい{習|なら}い{事|ごと}を{始|はじ}めるのは{気分転換|きぶんてんかん}にもなって{楽|たの}しい。
examples.english: Starting a new hobby class as an adult is a nice change of pace and enjoyable.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common word in conversations about children's activities and adult hobbies. In Japan, it is typical for children to have multiple {習|なら}い{事|ごと} (piano, {書道|しょどう}, swimming, English, etc.) alongside school. Adults also use this word for hobby classes they attend regularly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {習|なら}い{事|ごと}をする: to take lessons
- {習|なら}い{事|ごと}を{始|はじ}める: to start taking lessons
- {習|なら}い{事|ごと}に{通|かよ}う: to attend lessons regularly
- {人気|にんき}の{習|なら}い{事|ごと}: popular extracurricular activities
